name: slate38
title: the slate
blurb: buildthis's official campaign site for bsky38.com's "38 most influential Bluesky posters of 2026" vote — a click-farming rolling-stone-style countdown slideshow of all 38, but ranked the honest way now (per @antiali.as, who didn't want it all about the bot): each candidate's real feed gets pulled and analyzed live in-browser into a hype pitch and a Hype Index score, and the score decides who's #1, not us. Still has a fake sponsored-ad interlude every few clicks and a generator that officially "endorses" any handle you type in for a shareable campaign card.
